mapper.select: SELECT h.id AS house_id, h.title, h.house_type, h.region, h.price, h.area, h.rooms, f.created_at AS favorited_at FROM house_favorite f JOIN house h ON h.id = f.house_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM house_favorite f JOIN house h ON h.id = f.house_id AND h.deleted = 0 AND h.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
